name: Who Is Single?
original_name: รู้ไหมใครโสด
overview: A Thai game show where a single woman must find her perfect match from a group of men—while also guessing whether each man is single, taken, or part of the LGBTQ+ community. Across three rounds of clues, games, and personal reveals, she eliminates contestants one by one, with each exit exposing the truth about their relationship status before she makes her final choice.
